name: Aruji no Tame ni Kane wa Naru
original_name: お嬢様の為に鐘は鳴る
source:
There is a high school. Though it has huge school grounds and facilities, it is surrounded by tall walls. Closed society. No outsider can go inside. Actually, the school features the butler and maid training lessons. And, there is a local legend that if a master and a butler/maid swear under the clock tower located in the school, their relationship will last forever.... 

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
有一所高中。虽然拥有巨大的校园和设施，却被高墙环绕。封闭的社会。外人无法进入。实际上，这所学校以管家和女仆培训课程为特色。而且，当地有一个传说：如果主人和管家/女仆在学校的钟楼下起誓，他们的关系将永远持续……

[引自ErogeShop]
